title: 第21章 源质与序列第22章 脑子被动了手脚
slug: 降临即邪神开局绑架女武神
content_zh:
“等一下！”
花耶飞快地把门反锁，然后立刻瞪着大眼睛，啪嗒啪嗒地以最快的速度关上了窗户，刷一下拉上了窗帘。
伴随着烛火的亮起。
整个房间当中的景象也顿时浮现在了林恩的面前。
“放心吧！”
花耶认真地对他比了一个“y”。
“这里是花耶的房间，他们晚上肯定是不会再上来了！所以在这里住一晚，绝对是没有任何问题的！”
而林恩也终于看清楚了这个房间的样式，一张极其豪华的巨大的床摆在正中央，地上铺着一看就价值不菲的地毯，而无论是家具还是装饰，都绝对是想都不敢想的那种奢华。
林恩大致地丈量了一下。
他瞬间又蛋疼了。
“有没有搞错，你一个小萝莉的卧室，顶我家一百八十平！”
他立刻就想起了他穿越之前自己家住的房子，和这个相比，特么的还不如人家的一个卧室。
“哪里有！”
花耶瞪眼，飞快地换了一身睡衣过来，道：
“也不是只有我一个人住呀，我姐姐也和我睡一个屋子的，不过她早就成了驱魔师。”
“而且看今天这种情况，估计也肯定是不会回来的，放心，住你一个人绝对是没有任何问题的！”
林恩犹疑道：“你姐姐是驱魔师？”
对于她有一个姐姐他也并不诧异，因为那个叫做琼斯的家伙提了一下，那应该就是没错了。
花耶往大大的床上一躺，四仰八叉，闭眼道：
“那当然喽！很厉害的呢！那个家伙呀，可是从一生下来的时候，脑子里面就自带着很厉害的【源质】，要不然也不可能才那么大就早早地成为驱魔师呀！那可不是谁想进就可以进去的呢！”

林恩再一次想到了方才在路口遇到的那些家伙。
毫无疑问。
那些应该全部都是掌握着某些特殊力量的超凡能力者
“所以……”
林恩盘膝坐下，目光瞅着那个没用的萝莉。
“你们这里的力量体系是什么？还有你刚才说的什么……【源质】，那又是什么东西？”
能弄出那种庞大的法阵，虽然说肯定是远不如被他监禁的那个女武神，但是也足以说明，这绝对是一个怪力乱神的高魔世界。
花耶一愣，道：
“诶？你真的什么都不知道吗？”
林恩（ー′ー）道：
“我早就已经和你说过了啊，我失忆了，失忆了，要给你解释多少次才可以啊？”
花耶挠了挠后脑勺，懵懵地望着他。
“额……那我把我的课本拿给你……”
“呵，我文盲（冷笑）。”
content_en:
"Wait a minute!"
Huaye quickly locked the door, then immediately stared with big eyes, closed the window as quickly as possible, and closed the curtains with a brush.
With the lighting of candles.
The scene in the entire room suddenly appeared in front of Lin En.
"Don't worry!"
Hua Ye made a "y" sign to him seriously.
"This is Huaye's room. They will definitely not come up again at night! So there is absolutely no problem in staying here for one night!"
And Lin En finally saw the style of this room clearly. An extremely luxurious and huge bed was placed in the center, and the floor was covered with a carpet that looked very valuable at first glance. Both the furniture and decoration were absolutely luxurious that was beyond imagination.
Lynn took a rough measurement.
His balls ached again instantly.
"Are you mistaken? The bedroom of a little girl like you is worth 180 square meters of my house!"
He immediately remembered the house where his family lived before he traveled through time. Compared with this one, it was worse than a bedroom.
"Where is it!"
Hua Ye stared, quickly changed into pajamas and came over, saying:
"I'm not the only one living there. My sister also sleeps in the same room as me, but she has become an exorcist a long time ago."
"And looking at the situation today, I guess he won't come back. Don't worry, there will be absolutely no problem living alone!"
Linn hesitated and asked, "Is your sister an exorcist?"
He was not surprised that she had a sister, because the guy named Jones mentioned it, so it should be right.
Hua Ye lay down on the big bed, stretched out his arms, closed his eyes and said:
"Of course! He's very powerful! That guy has a very powerful [Essence] in his brain since he was born. Otherwise, it would be impossible to become an exorcist at such an early age! That's not something anyone can get in if they want to!"
Linn once again thought of the guys he met at the intersection.
There is no doubt about it.
Those should all be people with extraordinary abilities who possess certain special powers.
"So..."
Lin sat down cross-legged and looked at the useless loli.
"What is your power system here? And what you just said... [Essence], what is that?"
Being able to create such a huge magic circle is definitely far inferior to the Valkyrie who was imprisoned by him, but it is enough to show that this is definitely a world of high demons with strange powers and chaotic gods.
Huaye was stunned and said:
"Eh? Do you really know nothing?"
Lin En (ー′ー) said:
"I have told you a long time ago that I have lost my memory. I have lost my memory. How many times do I have to explain to you?"
Hua Ye scratched the back of his head and looked at him blankly.
"Well... then I'll give you my textbook..."
"Ha, I'm illiterate (sneer)."
